beyond_integration.config.comment.energy:
Enable auto-charging equipment-slot items: worn chargeable armor, accessories (Curios) and main/offhand tools & weapons are topped up from the player's primary network FE storage (maid: bound network)
Example: charge_enabled=true -> charge periodically while holding or wearing chargeable items
Ticks between each network charge attempt
FE extracted from network per charge attempt (fixed amount for RATE / flat part for PERCENTAGE_PLUS_RATE; capped by item's missing energy)
Charge mode: RATE = fixed charge_rate per interval; PERCENTAGE = charge_percentage% of max energy capacity; PERCENTAGE_PLUS_RATE = percentage + fixed rate
Percentage of max energy capacity used by percentage modes (0-100)

Auto-charge whitelist: supports item IDs (e.g. minecraft:diamond_sword) and tags (prefixed with #, e.g. #forge:tools); matched items are chargeable even if not tools/weapons; defaults include wireless terminals from AE2 / AE2WTLib / RS / WCWT
Enable Curios accessory auto-charging: chargeable curios worn by players and maids are topped up every interval (requires Curios)
Enable maid-exclusive accessory auto-charging: chargeable baubles in Touhou Little Maid's slots are topped up every interval (requires Touhou Little Maid)
beyond_integration.config.comment.potion: Networked potion charm settings: (Apotheosis) potion charms stored in a dimension network take effect on players bound to its primary network
Master switch of the networked potion charm module (when off, per-network potion charm toggles are ignored)

Ticks between adjacent networked potion charm settlement passes. Note: keep it no larger than "Refresh lead", otherwise an effect may expire between two passes and briefly drop (most visible with short-duration potions or a large interval)

Re-grant the effect when its remaining duration drops to this many ticks (i.e. shortly before expiry). Default 10. Should be no smaller than the settlement interval, otherwise the effect may expire before the next pass and briefly drop
Network XP consumed per Mending charm application (in XP points; 1 XP = 20 mB XP fluid)
beyond_integration.config.comment.enchan: Enchantment table workstation settings
Enchant power source: FIXED = fixed power (fixedPower), NETWORK_XP = power from network XP fluid (xpPerPower points each), PLAYER_LEVEL = power from player levels (levelPerPower levels each)
FIXED mode power (vanilla cap 15; up to 100 with uncapPower)
NETWORK_XP mode: XP points per 1 power
PLAYER_LEVEL mode: player levels per 1 power

Allow enchanting already-enchanted items: add new compatible enchantments or upgrade existing ones (low to high)
Conflicts are controlled by ignoreConflict
Allow adding enchantments that conflict with existing ones (works with ignoreEnchanted for enchanted items)
Free enchanting: no fuel consumed (the fuel slot may still be filled)
Auto-pull lapis from the primary network when the fuel slot is short (extracted only as needed).
Enable the enchant-table 'split enchantments' action (equipment -> enchanted books).
Apothic (Apotheosis) mode settings.
Whether shelf sacrifice is required to raise the four Apothic stat caps. When off, the network's scanned shelf values are ignored and the caps below apply directly (default on)

Ignore the shelf's own stat maximum shown as "Max X" in its tooltip (e.g. Draconic Endshelf's "Max 50") when sacrificing; with this on, contributions are limited only by the four config caps. Off by default
Eterna cap (0-100; 100 = no extra limit). With 'require sacrifice' on, scanned shelf values never exceed it
Quanta cap (0-100; 100 = no extra limit). With 'require sacrifice' on, scanned shelf values never exceed it
Arcana cap (0-100; 100 = no extra limit). With 'require sacrifice' on, scanned shelf values never exceed it
Rectification cap (0-100; 100 = no extra limit). With 'require sacrifice' on, scanned shelf values never exceed it
Remove the gate level: no longer requires player levels to reach it; XP points are charged based on the gate level instead (network XP first)
Remove the power cap 15 -> 100 (cost formula switches to the unclamped version)
Enchanting XP cost percentage: actual deduction is scaled by this percent (100 = full price, 50 = half price); applies to both gate-level and gate-ignored modes
Allow treasure enchantments from the enchanting table (e.g. Mending, Frost Walker; vanilla loot-only)
Enchantment IDs excluded from this table's rolls.
Server-side switch: hover preview (sends the list of enchantments to gain)
Server-side switch: refresh button (rerolls the three slot candidates)
Fuel consumed by the refresh button (0 = free; noLapis/creative are also free)
beyond_integration.config.comment.bd_twe: BD modifications (tweaks applied to Beyond Dimensions)
Enable XP Rod (beyonddimensions:xp_exchange_item) tweaks: target level cap / batched granting / direct granting (disable = vanilla BD behavior)

Bucket auto-separation on insert: fluid containers are split into fluid + empty container on network insert (default on)
When disabled, containers are stored as plain items

Only split bucket items (BucketItem subclasses) such as water / lava / modded fluid buckets.
When enabled (default), water bottles/potions and other non-bucket fluid containers are NOT split and are stored as plain items.
Disable to also split water bottles into water + glass bottles (the Thirst reverse fill relies on this).

Items listed here are NOT split by bucket auto-separation (stored as plain items on insert).
Entries are item registry names (e.g. kaleidoscope_tavern:grape_bucket); the namespace may be omitted (defaults to minecraft:) and namespace:* wildcards are supported.
Default: the Kaleidoscope Tavern juice buckets, so bottled drinks are not poured out.

Maximum re-entrancy depth of the insert handler chain for handlers other than the enchant-book separator: once reached they pass, preventing overly deep/cyclic recursion. Default 32, max 255 (the enchant-book separator is controlled separately by enchantment_separation.max_reentrancy, default 100).

Burn the Net Terminal as a furnace input to smelt ALL smeltable items in its bound network
When enabled: put a Beyond Dimensions Net Terminal in the furnace input slot (fuel the furnace); it is cooked into itself (NBT kept, NOT consumed) - taking the terminal out of the furnace then triggers smelting ALL smeltable items in its bound network at once; recipe XP is stored as network XP fluid (1 XP = 20 mB)
Default: disabled

Net furnace (item smelting) speed multiplier: cooking time = base / multiplier
1.0 = normal; higher = faster (e.g. 4.0 = 4x); range 0.1~100
Default: 1.0

Server switch: maintain a session-long sync of each online player's primary network (join -> logout)
Used by JEI stock badges/Shift-extract and other features that read primary-network data; when disabled, those features fall back to their own channels
Default: disabled
WARNING (performance): when enabled, the server continuously syncs each online player's primary network (full snapshot on join + per-tick merged deltas). On very large networks or with many players this adds notable bandwidth and CPU cost; enable only when needed.

Scope of primary-network sync:
ITEMS = items only (default, same as before)
STORAGE = all storage keys (incl. energy / soul)
STORAGE_EXT = storage keys + NetworkAmmoData extensions (virtual ammo / flags etc.)
Default: ITEMS

Enable debug logs and performance probes for primary-network sync (server & client).
Logs [BI-NetSync] events and warns on slow probes (>=5ms).
Default: false

Number of marker-slot rows on the Net Pathway (net_pathway), 1-6, global. Marker slots = rows x 9.
Default: 3 (i.e. 27 marker slots)

Max target level settable on the XP Rod (keep-mode target level)
Default 238609312 = highest level reachable through legal XP gains
Example: max_target_level=100000 -> allow keep target up to level 100000

Max XP granted per tick (batched granting to avoid int-overflow/precision issues)
Default Integer.MAX_VALUE-1 = effectively one shot per tick
Set a smaller value for smooth batched granting, 0 = also no batching
Example: grant_batch_size=1000000 -> grant at most 1,000,000 XP per tick until the target is reached

XP granting path:
BATCH = batched giveExperiencePoints (max level 238609312)
DIRECT = direct level set + progress + XP difference settlement (not bound by vanilla level formulas)
Example: grant_mode=DIRECT -> level/progress are set directly, difference paid from network

BI-added feature (not in Beyond Dimensions). The XP Rod repairs damaged Mending gear with network XP; 1 XP = 2 durability.
Default: enabled

BI-added feature. PERCENT: each repair is a % of max durability. ABSOLUTE: each repair is xp_repair_absolute.
Default: PERCENT

BI-added feature. One tier per entry: name:percent:interval (interval in ticks). Percent = max durability % repaired per action; ABSOLUTE mode ignores it.
Default: low:5:20, normal:10:10, high:20:5, max:50:1

ABSOLUTE mode: durability per action
Default: 100

When enabled, the maid XP rod ignores TLM's maid_mending_blocklist_item tag while repairing equipment/baubles (e.g. Ultramarine Orb Elixir, which supports Mending but is blacklisted for maid pickup repair). Off by default (matches TLM behavior)

true = reset death time

beyond_integration.config.comment.goety_: Goety network soul source: use the dimension network as an extra soul source. Disabled by default (behavior unchanged when off).
Master switch. When off, no network soul draw/precipitation logic is registered.
When on, a network must be activated by the soul-source ritual before its soul storage works; when off, every network is treated as already active. Default: off
When gaining soul energy from kills, fill the vanilla container (Arca/totem) first; only the overflow is precipitated into the network (extra source).
Overflow precipitation ratio (0-1): 0.5 sends half of the overflow soul energy to the network.
Allow a command to manually convert player soul energy into network souls.
When the cage/ritual has no soul talisman (or lacks native souls), use the caster's primary network directly.
Network soul cap: souls inserted into the network are truncated to this value (0 = unlimited). Default: 0 (unlimited); set a positive value to enforce a real cap.
Emit network soul source debug logs (register/activate/draw/precipitate).

Allow network soul to participate in revival: only when vanilla (Arca/totem) cannot revive, if vanilla + network souls total at least the vanilla MaxSouls cost, consume vanilla first then the network remainder, and revive. On by default.
On network revive, teleport to the bound Arca if present; otherwise revive in place.
When on, the network-covered remainder also obeys soulDiscount (armor soul-cost reduction); when off (default) the network remainder is charged at full price.

Goety rituals (network bypass group): when the trigger blocks are present near the altar, environment checks (night/dimension/biome/height/weather) and structure block requirements (filled from the network) can be bypassed. Both are independent switches.
Master switch. When on and the trigger conditions below are met near the altar, vanilla ritual environment checks are skipped (structure blocks still required).

Extra soul consumed when the environment bypass takes effect (per ritual; charged once at ritual start regardless of the ritual's outcome). Uses the same soul source as the ritual: cursed cage (vanilla first, network covers the shortfall) → network pathway. If the soul is insufficient, the bypass is blocked. 0 = off. Default 100.
Required count of beyonddimensions:net_pathway within the radius. Default 5.
Required count of beyonddimensions:dimensional_connect_block within the radius. Default 16.
Radius (blocks) around the altar to scan for trigger blocks. Default 8.

Allow the cursed cage directly below the altar to be replaced by a dimension network pathway (beyonddimensions:net_pathway): the caster's primary network is then used as the soul source (no cage needed).

When the vanilla ritual structure check fails, fill the shortfall from block items in the network (the network inventory is scanned once and cached). When triggered, the extra soul cost below is charged once and a hint is shown to the player. Flower pots are counted as 'pot body + content' via exact keys. Default: enabled.

Extra soul consumed when structure blocks are supplied by the network (at most once per structure check). Uses the same soul source as the ritual: cursed cage (vanilla first, network covers the shortfall) → network pathway. If the soul is insufficient, blocks are not supplied (the vanilla failure stands). 0 = off. Default 100.
